text: Seabrook Town logró una increíble victoria 4-2 contra Harbour City, remontando tras estar 0-2 abajo con goles al final del partido. Harbour City empezó fuerte, dominando con un estilo paciente y pases cortos, y anotó dos veces justo antes y después del descanso, gracias a Elias Okafor y Marek Barros, este último figura del partido con una puntuación de 9.8 y 14.74 km recorridos [#905] [#975]. Sin embargo, a partir del minuto 65, Seabrook cambió su táctica a un juego más intenso y directo para presionar alto, lo que les permitió controlar mejor el balón y crear más oportunidades [#1361]. Kian Romano fue el héroe con dos goles en tiempo de descuento, siendo sus tiros altamente probables de entrar (xG 0.609 y 0.959, que significa que casi garantizaban gol), asegurando la remontada [#1882] [#1906]. El partido mostró la fuerza del juego por las bandas y los contraataques eficaces de Seabrook, que aprovecharon los espacios para dar vuelta el marcador.

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in es

- Seabrook Town defeated Harbour City 4-2 with an xG advantage of 3.48 to 1.00 reflecting better quality chances [#summary].
- Kian Romano scored twice in stoppage time (90+2' and 90+3') with high xG values of 0.609 and 0.959, securing Seabrook Town's comeback and win [#1882,#1906].
- Harbour City led 2-0 with goals right before and after half-time by Elias Okafor (xG 0.111) and Marek Barros (xG 0.009) [#905,#975].
- Seabrook Town intensified press and direct play tactics from the 65th minute, contributing to their second-half dominance and comeback [#1361].
- Marek Barros was player of the match with 1 goal, 2 assists, 9 interceptions, and a high rating of 9.8 covering 14.74 km [#summary].

- Harbour City’s opening goal by Elias Okafor at 45' came from a patient buildup involving 17 passes over nearly a minute, reflecting their 4-2-3-1 formation and “patient short passing” style. The goal was assisted by Marek Barros with a through pass, indicating a controlled and precise approach to breaking down the Seabrook defense [#905].

- Marek Barros’ second goal at 47' resulted from a quick attack starting from a corner, involving only one pass before his long-distance finish. This shows Harbour City’s ability to exploit set-pieces efficiently within their structured formation, possibly catching Seabrook’s three-at-the-back system off guard [#975].

- Seabrook Town responded with increasing intensity after 65' by pressing higher and playing more direct, as instructed by their coach, Mara Lindholm. Their switch to a higher press and more direct play reflects their 3-4-3 formation optimized for wide and crossing play, aiming to unsettle Harbour City and regain control of the match [#1361].

- The late goals from Seabrook, including Kian Romano’s counter-attack goal at 90+2', were the product of regains quickly transitioned into attacks with few passes and rapid movement. This tactic suits their formation’s emphasis on width and crossing, enabling them to exploit spaces left by Harbour City’s chasing and pressing in the final minutes [#1882].
